news.headline: Dragon Heads Home From the Space Station
news.body: A SpaceX Dragon spacecraft packed with science experiments and cargo undocked from the International Space Station on Friday. It is set to splash down in the ocean off the California coast on Saturday afternoon. No astronauts are on board, just science from space!

news.headline: Build a Paper Rocket and Launch It With a Straw
news.body: Science Buddies shared a fun experiment: make tube-shaped rockets from paper and tape, then launch them by blowing through a drinking straw. A rocket without fins spins out of control, but one with fins flies straighter. Try both and see which goes farthest!
